source: South Dakota official published active Scratch subset

catalogs.coverage: Explicitly active Scratch entries in the published listing only. Listing completeness/pagination unconfirmed (100 entries at initial audit). catalogs.updateCadence: Checked every six hours; official inventory publication cadence unconfirmed.
